<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
register_operator_handlers(kind: str, handler: Callable) -> None
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Register the operator handler for `SymbolicTensor` dispatch kind `kind`.

Called by `evoxc.ops` at import time so `SymbolicTensor.__add__` etc.
build IR ops without `core` importing `ops` (import acyclicity).
Re-registering a kind replaces the previous handler.

## Parameters

- `kind` · `str` — Dispatch kind — one of `"add"`, `"sub"`, `"mul"`,
  `"matmul"`, `"truediv"`, `"pow"`, `"neg"`, `"lt"`,
  `"gt"`, `"le"`, `"ge"`, `"eq"`, `"getitem"`.

- `handler` · `Callable` — Callable following the calling convention documented in the
  module docstring.

## Raises

- `TypeError` — If `handler` is not callable.
